shortDescription: Add, modify & delete services within a consul cluster.

options.name: check_id
options.description: an ID for the service check. If I(state=absent), defaults to I(check_name). Ignored if part of a service definition.

options.name: check_name
options.description: a name for the service check. Required if standalone, ignored if part of service definition.

options.name: dc
options.description: The datacenter that this agent will communicate with. By default the datacenter of the host is used.

options.name: host
options.description: host of the consul agent defaults to localhost

options.name: http
options.description: checks can be registered with an HTTP endpoint. This means that consul will check that the http endpoint returns a successful HTTP status. I(interval) must also be provided with this option.

options.name: interval
options.description: the interval at which the service check will be run. This is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes e.g C(15s) or C(1m). If no suffix is supplied, m will be used by default e.g. C(1) will be C(1m). Required if the I(script) parameter is specified.

options.name: notes
options.description: Notes to attach to check when registering it.

options.name: port
options.description: the port on which the consul agent is running

options.name: scheme
options.description: the protocol scheme on which the consul agent is running

options.name: script
options.description: the script/command that will be run periodically to check the health of the service. Scripts require I(interval) and vice versa.

options.name: service_address
options.description: the address to advertise that the service will be listening on. This value will be passed as the I(address) parameter to Consul's U(/v1/agent/service/register) API method, so refer to the Consul API documentation for further details.

options.name: service_id
options.description: the ID for the service, must be unique per node. If I(state=absent), defaults to the service name if supplied.

options.name: service_name
options.description: Unique name for the service on a node, must be unique per node, required if registering a service. May be omitted if registering a node level check

options.name: service_port
options.description: the port on which the service is listening. Can optionally be supplied for registration of a service, i.e. if I(service_name) or I(service_id) is set

options.name: state
options.description: register or deregister the consul service, defaults to present

options.name: tags
options.description: tags that will be attached to the service registration.

options.name: tcp
options.description: Checks can be registered with a TCP port. This means that consul will check if the connection attempt to that port is successful (that is, the port is currently accepting connections). The format is C(host:port), for example C(localhost:80). I(interval) must also be provided with this option.

options.name: timeout
options.description: A custom HTTP check timeout. The consul default is 10 seconds. Similar to the interval this is a number with a C(s) or C(m) suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, e.g. C(15s) or C(1m).

options.name: token
options.description: the token key identifying an ACL rule set. May be required to register services.

options.name: ttl
options.description: checks can be registered with a ttl instead of a I(script) and I(interval) this means that the service will check in with the agent before the ttl expires. If it doesn't the check will be considered failed. Required if registering a check and the script an interval are missing Similar to the interval this is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes e.g C(15s) or C(1m). If no suffix is supplied, C(m) will be used by default e.g. C(1) will be C(1m)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: whether to verify the TLS certificate of the consul agent
